prompts.title: From Blank Hallway to Luxe Feature Wall
prompts.hook: See how a dull hallway becomes a luxe feature in 3 steps
prompts.visual_scene: A narrow hallway with plain white walls and generic lighting. The scene is captured from a low angle, showing the length of the space. No text or signage is visible; only the architectural details and the subtle play of shadows.
prompts.caption:
See how a dull hallway becomes a luxe feature in 3 steps

🟢 Step 1: Choose a bold, vertically‑striped wallpaper that adds height.
🟢 Step 2: Apply our zero‑damage paste technique—no wall damage, easy removal.
🟢 Step 3: Add simple LED strip lighting to highlight the pattern.

The transformation is instant, budget‑friendly, and perfect for first‑time home buyers.

💌 Want a spec concept for your own space? DM "AD" with your brief and we’ll design the look.

#HallwayMakeover #BeforeAfter #WallpaperDIY #InteriorDesignIndia #DIYTips #HomeMakeover #BudgetRenovation #EcoFriendlyLiving
prompts.prompt_text:
Develop a single‑image post for the First‑Time Home Buyer persona (22‑35, Ahmedabad). The image must show a stark before‑and‑after comparison of a hallway, using a split‑screen layout that is visually striking without any overlaid text. The left side displays the bland, white‑wall hallway; the right side reveals the same space after applying a bold vertical‑stripe wallpaper, subtle LED accent lighting, and a small decorative runner rug. The caption follows a before‑after hook, lists three concrete design steps, and ends with a CTA inviting DMs with "AD" for a free spec concept. Use the brand’s educational tone and include eight hashtags mixing hyper‑niche, industry, and broad discovery tags. This post targets saves and profile visits by offering a clear, replicable makeover blueprint.

Visual deliverable: create exactly one finished static image, with the complete composition in a single frame.
prompts.angle: Show a concrete before‑after transformation to inspire budget‑friendly makeovers for new homeowners.
key_factors: Strong before‑after hook aligns with trending contrarian and before‑after patterns
Clear, actionable design steps and CTA target profile visits and inquiries
Visual split‑screen is scroll‑stopping and encourages saves for future reference
risks: No direct product showcase (wallpaper brand not highlighted) may dilute ad‑creative offer
High reliance on a single image may limit engagement compared to multi‑post carousels
Potential cultural mismatch if LED lighting or runner rug styles are not locally resonant
prompts.reasoning: The prompt leverages proven before‑after virality and offers a concrete makeover blueprint, which fits the First‑Time Home Buyer persona. However, the lack of explicit product branding and the single‑image format reduce its potential to convert saves into sales, keeping the score in the medium range.
improvement_hints: Add a subtle brand logo or watermark to reinforce the studio’s offer
Include a short carousel of the wallpaper samples or a quick 15‑second Reel to boost engagement
Use local color palettes or Gujarati motifs in the runner rug to increase cultural relevance
Add a swipe‑up link or link‑in‑bio CTA for instant booking of a free spec concept
warnings: Below your quality bar (58/100, bar 75) - review before posting.
